title: Can three chemical parks fix India's import problem?

scenes.title: Can three chemical parks fix India's import problem?
scenes.say: India is betting ₹3,030 crore on three new chemical parks. Can they fix its import problem?
scenes.speak: India is betting three thousand and thirty crore rupees on three new chemical parks. Can they fix its import problem?

scenes.label: India's trade deficit in key chemical products, 2023
scenes.say: Chemicals go into almost everything India makes, from fertilisers to plastics to medicines. Yet in 2023, key chemical products left India with a trade deficit of $31 billion.
scenes.speak: Chemicals go into almost everything India makes, from fertilisers to plastics to medicines. Yet in twenty twenty-three, key chemical products left India with a trade deficit of thirty-one billion dollars.

scenes.title: India imports up to 90% of its methanol
scenes.detail: 3,309 kilo tonnes used in FY2024–25. The dependence is projected to last to FY2029–30.
scenes.say: Take methanol, a basic building block for other chemicals. India uses about 3.3 million tonnes a year, and imports up to 90% of it.
scenes.speak: Take methanol, a basic building block for other chemicals. India uses about three point three million tonnes a year, and imports up to ninety per cent of it.

scenes.title: BHAVYA Rasayan: three parks in five years
scenes.say: The government's answer is BHAVYA Rasayan, approved by the Union Cabinet in July. It runs for five years, to 2031.
scenes.speak: The government's answer is Bhuv-ya Ra-saa-yun, approved by the Union Cabinet in July. It runs for five years, to twenty thirty-one.

scenes.title: What each park gets
scenes.source: BHAVYA Rasayan guidelines, via The Secretariat
scenes.say: Each park can get up to ₹1,000 crore from the Centre, and at least ₹500 crore from its state, on a minimum of 8 sq km of land.
scenes.speak: Each park can get up to a thousand crore rupees from the Centre, and at least five hundred crore from its state, on a minimum of eight square kilometres of land.

scenes.title: A park only works as an ecosystem
scenes.say: But experts say land and pipes are the easy part. A park becomes an ecosystem only when one company's output becomes another company's input.

scenes.title: India's three petrochemical regions
scenes.say: India has tried this before. Its three petrochemical regions, at Dahej, Visakhapatnam-Kakinada and Paradip, report more than 2,000 units and 3.7 lakh jobs. What's less clear is how much they have cut imports.
scenes.speak: India has tried this before. Its three petrochemical regions, at Dahej, Visakhapatnam-Kakinada and Paradip, report more than two thousand units and three point seven lakh jobs. What's less clear is how much they have cut imports.

scenes.text: The biggest gap is between proving that something works and proving that it works repeatedly at industrial scale.
scenes.say: The other gap is getting new chemistry out of the lab. The hard part, as one founder puts it, is proving it works again and again at industrial scale. The scheme doesn't yet pay for pilot plants or first trials.

scenes.title: Not whether the parks get built, but…
items: How much value stays in India
scenes.say: So the real test isn't whether the parks get built. It's how fast they start production, how much of their capacity is used, how much value stays in India, and whether exports grow.
